label: The selected evil utterance is not true…, from Excluded middle as a general principle… and 4 more
meaning: Compose the existing external-emotivism theorem with the checked coverage-with-remainder result: under all four strict semantic bridges the own-true-premise branch is excluded, leaving internal challenge, affective protest or explicit remaining use. This classifies a limitation of one objection-use, not falsehood of emotivism or proof of God.
